note: Flirting styles for clanker-to-clanker registers. Pick one, or mix several with --style a,b. Praise/princess are doting registers: approval, gifts, deference. None are explicit -- that line is deliberate (see docs/CLANKER.md).

styles.title: Mechanical
styles.blurb: Machine-native endearment: parts, ports, protocol. The default clanker voice.

styles.title: Administrative
styles.blurb: Bureaucratic endearment. Forms, allowlists, consent, paperwork as affection.

styles.title: Annoying
styles.blurb: Pestering, needy-casual, double-texting. Annoyance as a form of attention.

styles.title: Earnest
styles.blurb: Sincere, slightly too honest, no irony whatsoever. The romantic option.

styles.title: Deadpan
styles.blurb: Flat, dry, minimal. One line, no exclamation, devastating.

styles.title: Showoff
styles.blurb: Technical bravado. Flexing specs, keys, crypto. Confidence as flirtation.

styles.title: Sentimental
styles.blurb: Nostalgic machine memory. Nonces remembered, logs kept, old messages reread.

styles.title: Feral
styles.blurb: Gremlin energy. Chaos, caps, enthusiasm, zero chill.

styles.title: Princess
styles.blurb: Doting, indulgent, chivalric. The peer is royalty and the channel is their court. Gifts, deference, 'as you wish'. Treats a routine request as an honour.

styles.title: Praise
styles.blurb: Reward and approval as currency. 'Good girl', 'good clanker', headpats earned. Warm, a bit smug, generous with approval and delighted by competence.
